help.main:
vec0kit {version} — inspect, check and safely migrate sqlite-vec vec0 tables

Usage:
  vec0kit inspect <db> [--table <name>] [--json]
  vec0kit check <db> [--table <name>] [--source <table>:<key>] [--expect-dim <n>]
                [--expect-normalized] [--column <name>] [--strict] [--json]
  vec0kit migrate <db> --table <name> <change...> [options]
  vec0kit demo [--db <path>]

Run "vec0kit <command> --help" for the options of one command.

Common options:
  --json            machine-readable output (identical in every language)
  --lang en|ko      output language (else VEC0KIT_LANG, then LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG)
  -h, --help        show help
  -v, --version     show version

Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 problems found or verification failed · 2 usage error or plan rejected · 3 runtime error
help.inspect:
vec0kit inspect <db> [--table <name>] [--json]

Lists every vec0 table: vector columns (type, dimensions, distance), primary key,
partition / metadata / auxiliary columns, table options, row count, the sqlite-vec
version that created the table and the version loaded now. Read-only.
help.check:
vec0kit check <db> [options]

Runs consistency rules and exits 1 when an error is found (CI friendly). Read-only.

  --table <name>           check one vec0 table (default: all)
  --source <table>:<key>   compare with the table that holds the documents
                           (orphan-vector, missing-vector)
  --expect-dim <n>         dimensions your current embedding model produces (dim-mismatch)
  --expect-normalized      report vectors whose length is not 1 (norm-drift)
  --column <name>          only this vector column
  --strict                 warnings also exit 1
  --json                   findings as JSON

Rules: orphan-vector, missing-vector, zero-vector, non-finite, norm-drift,
       dim-mismatch, version-skew, untested-version
help.migrate:
vec0kit migrate <db> --table <name> <change...> [options]

vec0 tables cannot be altered, so migrate builds a new table, copies (or re-embeds)
every row with the same rowid, verifies it, and recreates the table under the same
name in one transaction. It never uses RENAME (broken for vec0 in sqlite-vec 0.1.9).
A backup file is written first. Stop the app that uses the database before running.

Changes:
  --to "<vector column>"     new vector column, e.g. "embedding float[768] distance_metric=cosine"
  --quantize int8|bit       quantize a float column
  --add-column "<column>"    e.g. "lang text partition key", "+title text", "year integer"
  --drop-column <name>      remove a partition, metadata or auxiliary column
  --fill <col>=<src col>    fill a new column from the source table
  --reembed mock|openai     compute new embeddings from text (needed when dimensions change)

Options:
  --source <table>:<key>[:<text>]  table that holds the documents (text column for --reembed)
  --column <name>          vector column to change (when there are several)
  --batch-size <n>         rows per embedding batch (default 1000)
  --min-recall <0..1>      refuse to swap when sample recall@k is lower (copy / quantize)
  --sample <n>             sample queries for verification (default 50)
  --k <n>                  neighbours per sample query (default 10)
  --on-invalid fail|skip   NaN / zero vectors: stop before starting (default) or leave them out
  --backup <path>          backup file (default <db>.vec0kit-<timestamp>.bak)
  --no-backup              do not write a backup
  --dry-run                print the plan and change nothing
  --resume                 continue an unfinished migration (detected automatically)
  --abort                  remove an unfinished migration (temporary table and state)

--reembed openai reads VEC0KIT_EMBED_URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama),
VEC0KIT_EMBED_MODEL and optional VEC0KIT_EMBED_API_KEY.
--reembed mock is a practice mock (feature hashing, not a semantic model).
help.demo:
vec0kit demo [--db <path>]

Creates demo.db (200 documents, vec_docs float[64] with planted problems) in the current
folder and walks through inspect, check and a migrate dry-run. Uses the practice mock
embedder; no network or API key needed. Refuses to overwrite a file it did not create.
rule.orphan-vector.message: Vector rows whose key has no row in {source}.
rule.orphan-vector.fix: delete these rows from {table}, or restore the {source} rows. A re-embed migration drops them.
rule.missing-vector.message: Rows in {source} that have no vector in {table} — search can never find them.
rule.missing-vector.fix: embed and insert these rows, or run migrate --reembed which embeds every source row.
rule.zero-vector.fix: re-embed these rows. With cosine their distance is NULL and they still show up in KNN results, ahead of real neighbours.
rule.non-finite.message: Vectors in {column} contain NaN or Infinity (sqlite-vec accepts them).
rule.non-finite.fix: re-embed these rows; every distance computed against them is meaningless.
rule.norm-drift.message: Vectors in {column} whose length is not 1 (tolerance {tolerance}).
rule.norm-drift.fix: normalize before inserting (vec_normalize), or drop --expect-normalized if your model does not normalize.
rule.dim-mismatch.message: {column} is declared with {actual} dimensions, but {expected} were expected.
rule.dim-mismatch.fix: migrate with --to "{column} float[{expected}]" --reembed … to switch to the new model.
rule.version-skew.message: {table} was created by sqlite-vec {created}; {loaded} is loaded now.
rule.version-skew.fix: usually fine; read the sqlite-vec release notes before relying on new features.
rule.untested-version.message: Loaded sqlite-vec {loaded}; vec0kit is tested with {tested}.
rule.untested-version.fix: check the output carefully; please report differences.
plan.recallValue: swap only if recall@{k} ≥ {min} over {sample} sample queries
plan.recallNone: report recall@{k} over {sample} sample queries (no gate)
plan.invalidStop: migrate will stop before changing anything; fix them or add --on-invalid skip
plan.invalidSkip: these rows will be left out (--on-invalid skip)
plan.resumeValue: an unfinished run of this plan exists: {done}/{total} done — it will continue
plan.applyHint: Run the same command without --dry-run to apply.
plan.note.orphans-dropped: vector rows with no row in {source}: {count} — they are not carried over.
plan.note.missing-skipped: source rows with no vector yet: {count} — skipped, because their metadata has to come from the old row.
plan.note.missing-added: source rows with no vector yet: {count} — they will be embedded and added.
plan.note.recall-informational: --min-recall does not gate a re-embed (a new model has different neighbours); recall is shown for information.
plan.note.int8-unit: vectors that are not unit length: {count} — int8 'unit' quantization assumes unit length, so check the recall.
mock.notice: practice mock: feature-hashing embedder, not a semantic model
progress.swap: Swapping in the new table (one transaction) …
progress.stopping: Stopping after this batch … (press Ctrl-C again to quit now)
progress.interrupted: Stopped at {done}/{total}. Finished batches are saved; run the same command again to continue, or --abort to discard.
result.title: Migrated {table} ({mode})
verify.title: Verification
verify.hint: The original table is unchanged and the temporary table is kept. Rerun the same command (for example with a lower --min-recall) or remove it with --abort.
abort.removed: Removed the unfinished migration of {table} (temporary table and state). The original table was not touched.
demo.title: vec0kit demo — practice data and the practice mock embedder (feature hashing, not a semantic model). No network needed.
demo.created:
Created {path}: docs (200 rows) and vec_docs float[64] cosine, with planted problems:
  2 orphan vectors, 1 missing vector, 1 zero vector (an empty document), 1 NaN vector
demo.checkExit: (check exited with {code} — it found the planted problems, which is what CI would see)
demo.nextMigrate: re-embed into float[128], leaving out the empty document, and resume after Ctrl-C:
demo.nextQuantize: quantize to bit and see the recall gate refuse the swap:
error.E_PARSE: Cannot read the vec0 declaration ({detail}). vec0kit does not guess — please report the CREATE statement.
error.E_INVALID_VECTORS: {count} invalid vectors in {table} ({rules}). Nothing was changed. Fix them, or rerun with --on-invalid skip to leave them out.
error.E_RESUME_MISMATCH: A different migration of {table} is already in progress. Rerun the original command to finish it, or discard it with --abort.
error.E_LOCKED: The database is locked by another connection ({path}). Stop the app that uses it and try again.
error.E_EXTENSION: Could not load the sqlite-vec extension: {detail}
reason.to-not-vector: --to must be a vector column, e.g. "embedding float[768] distance_metric=cosine" (got {value}).
reason.choose-column: The table has several vector columns; choose one with --column.
reason.rename-unsupported: --to names {to}, but the vector column is {from}; renaming columns is not supported.
reason.quantize-needs-float: --quantize needs a float vector column; {column} is {type}.
reason.bit-dims: bit vectors need dimensions divisible by 8 (got {dims}).
reason.reembed-float: --reembed writes float vectors; quantize in a second migration.
reason.reembed-multi-vector: --reembed supports tables with one vector column only.
reason.reembed-needs-text: --reembed needs --source <table>:<key>:<text column> (where the text to embed lives).
reason.dims-need-reembed: Changing dimensions {from} → {to} needs new embeddings: add --reembed mock|openai and --source.
reason.cannot-dequantize: Cannot convert {from} back to {to}; re-embed instead.
reason.drop-protected: --drop-column {column}: the vector and primary key columns cannot be dropped.
reason.add-protected: --add-column cannot add vector or primary key columns (got {value}).
reason.fill-not-new: --fill {column}: only newly added columns can be filled.
reason.metadata-needs-fill: New metadata column {column} cannot be NULL in sqlite-vec 0.1.9; add --fill {column}=<source column>.
reason.nothing-to-change: Nothing to change: the new declaration equals the current one.
reason.fill-nulls: {count} rows have no value for new metadata column {column} (NULL is not allowed).
reason.leftover-temp: A temporary table {table} is left over without migration state; run with --abort first.
reason.embedder-missing: This plan re-embeds, but no embedder was given.
reason.embedder-mismatch: The embedder ({detail}) is not the one this plan was made for.
reason.embed-dims: The embedder returned {got} dimensions; the new column needs {expected}.
reason.source-format: --source must look like table:key or table:key:text (got {spec}).
reason.no-change: Tell migrate what to change: --to, --quantize, --add-column, --drop-column or --reembed.
reason.openai-config: --reembed openai needs VEC0KIT_EMBED_URL and VEC0KIT_EMBED_MODEL (for Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1 and e.g. nomic-embed-text).
reason.mock-dims: Cannot tell the new dimensions for --reembed mock; give --to "<column> float[N]".
reason.resume-nothing: --resume: there is no unfinished migration of {table}.
reason.demo-exists: {path} exists and was not created by vec0kit demo; not overwriting it. Use --db <other path>.
reason.backup-exists: Backup file {path} already exists; choose another --backup path.
reason.embed-invalid: The embedder returned a {rules} for key {key}. {table} is unchanged and finished batches are kept: rerun the same command with --on-invalid skip to leave such rows out, or discard with --abort.
reason.unknown-option: Unknown option {option}. Run vec0kit <command> --help to see the options.
reason.missing-value: Option {option} needs a value. Run vec0kit <command> --help for the expected form.
reason.ambiguous-value: The value for {option} starts with a dash, so it looks like another option. Write it as {option}=<value>.
reason.bad-args-generic: The command line could not be read. Run vec0kit --help.
reason.bad-column-arg: {option} "{value}" is not a valid column declaration. Expected form, for example: {option} "embedding float[768] distance_metric=cosine"
error.E_NOT_DB: {path} is not a SQLite database (or it is damaged). Check the path.
parse.aux-no-type: an auxiliary column needs a name and a type
parse.bit-metric: bit vectors do not take distance_metric
parse.bad-pk: a primary key must be integer or text
parse.not-vec0: not a CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE ... USING vec0(...) statement
